call_window.note: Local time of the recipient. Never inferred from the phone number, area code, locale, or server time.

disclosure_elements.description: The call names the calling entity and, when acting for a creditor, who it is calling on behalf of.
The call states that the caller is an automated or AI assistant.
FDCPA 1692e(11) purpose disclosure: an attempt to collect a debt and information obtained will be used for that purpose.
The call tells the recipient how to stop future calls.

rules.name: call_window
rules.requirement: Dial only between 08:00 and 21:00 in the recipient's stored local timezone.

rules.name: consent_on_file
rules.requirement: Dial only when prior express consent is recorded with a consent timestamp.

rules.name: not_suppressed
rules.requirement: Never dial a number on the opt-out or do-not-call suppression list.

rules.name: disclosure_ready
rules.requirement: The rendered call script must contain every required disclosure element before the call is placed.

rules.name: live_revocation
rules.requirement: If the recipient revokes consent during the call, end the call, record the opt-out, and suppress the number.

revocation_phrases: put me on your do not call list
